slides.kicker: G · OPEN SOURCE ORCHESTRA DAO MEET
slides.title: The First Circle
slides.lede: Before the ripple, one bright and honest heartbeat.
bullets: The orchestra is whoever shows up: no auditions, no gatekeepers, no wrong instrument.
Music, code, listening, translation and care belong in the same circle.
This is a consent-based community proposal—not an onchain DAO or automatic membership.

slides.kicker: G · FIRST CIRCLE · EVERY CONTRIBUTION EQUAL
slides.title: A first circle, not a hierarchy
slides.lede: Locked-solid principles. An open door. One consenting human, one voice.
bullets: Code and music, artists, builders, stewards, translators and sound crew: every contribution is equal.
IN, LATER and NO are equally respected; an invite, photo or RSVP is not enrolment.
No token sale, donation-weighted influence, agent votes, keys, Shamans or execution.
Whole-circle funding is shared equally by default; restricted grants follow their terms.

slides.title: Consent is the first note
slides.lede: Attendance is not recording consent. Recording is not publication consent.
bullets: Names, faces, wallets, quotes and transcripts each require their own appropriate yes.
Private contacts, attendee lists and current meeting links never enter this public hall.
Silence is not consent; a takedown request comes first, questions second.
Agents are labelled as machines; no pictured person is presented as a DAO endorser.
slides.status: CONSENT ALWAYS · DOWN FIRST · AI LABELLED

slides.kicker: Em · TRANSPARENT COMMUNITY LEDGER · DATED SNAPSHOT
slides.title: A ledger everyone can read
slides.lede: Today's DAO is a public community record and proposal—not an onchain treasury.
bullets: 9 Nov 2026 snapshot · 4 applied · 7 prepared · $0 awarded.
Applications, answers, awards, splits, objections and results belong in the open.
No current treasury migration, existing-asset move, token sale or promised payout.
Artist tips stay direct gifts, not a DAO custody pool.

links.label: Artist-first tip page · mainnet and practice testnets

slides.kicker: C · PROPOSED DAO PHASES · A PATH, NOT A DECISION
slides.title: Move at the speed of trust
slides.lede: The tools come after the listening—not before it.
bullets: 01 · First Circle — reconcile IN / LATER / NO and publish a consent-based charter for review.
02 · Practice — community Git ledger, privately verified humans and equal offchain signalling.
03 · Execute only if chosen — human-only Safe with public receipts; agents never hold keys.
04 · Binding tools only after rehearsal — Snapshot X, Aragon or another explicit circle choice.
slides.status: PROPOSED ONLY · NO SAFE OR CONTRACT DEPLOYED

slides.kicker: D · THIRD OPEN SOURCE ORCHESTRA DAO MEETUP
slides.title: The third meetup is open to all
slides.lede: Bring a song, a question, a skill, or simply your attention. Details to be announced.
bullets: OPEN INVITE FOR EVERYONE · musicians, builders, listeners, translators and curious guests.
This First Circle prepares the door; attending the open meetup does not enrol anyone in the DAO.
No date, time, place or public meeting link has been confirmed here yet.
When blessed, the invitation will live here—open, accessible and without a wallet requirement.
